sourceOriginChain.derivationNote: Issue #250 measured the untried MADR 0050 steps 2-4 paths plus the global-simplify control: the #239 ladder flattened at 106,025 tris because lockBorder=true stalls this open-shell mesh near 67k boundary edges. The direct-target global simplify (meshopt simplify, error 0.005, no lockBorder) reached exactly 60,000 tris with min silhouette IoU 0.9854 and exterior area retained 0.9992, so the monitor clears the 60k per-asset ceiling WITHOUT a budget exception. This promote copies the decimated output byte-identical (sha256 cff08df0...) from .openclinxr/evidence/issue-250/outputs/ into the tracked medical-equipment library; no re-bake, no re-decimation.
